definitions: A severe and chronic medical condition characterized by heightened sensitivity to various chemicals and environmental substances, often at levels that do not affect the general population.
A type of computer system or software that manages and controls multiple concurrent processes or tasks.
A specific type of integrated circuit or chip, often referring to a microcontroller series.
examples: She was diagnosed with MCS after years of unexplained symptoms.
The new MCS improved the efficiency of data processing.
The engineer selected an MCS for the embedded system.
